AdminAccount.title: AdminAccount
AdminAccount.description: Administrator marker record granting admin privileges.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin record was created.

UserPublicProfile.title: UserPublicProfile
UserPublicProfile.description: Public profile, unlocked courses, and learning progress summary for an authenticated student account.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

username.description: Display username chosen by the user.

unlockedTuneIn.description: Whether the Tune In listening section is unlocked for this user.

unlockedMagicSounds.description: Whether the full Magic Sounds course is unlocked for this user.

unlockedSoundCode.description: Whether the full Sound Code course is unlocked for this user.

unlockedSoundToSpeech.description: Whether the full Sound to Speech course is unlocked for this user.

learnedSoundsCount.description: Total number of phonics sounds practiced by the student.

completedBooksCount.description: Total number of decodable books completed by the student.

lastStudiedItem.description: Description of the most recent lesson or sound practiced.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

UserPrivateInfo.title: UserPrivateInfo
UserPrivateInfo.description: Isolated PII record containing the user's private email address.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

email.description: Verified email address of the user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the private record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the private record was updated.

ActivationCode.title: ActivationCode
ActivationCode.description: One-time course activation code bound to a specific student email address.

targetEmail.description: Lowercase email address of the student who completed bank transfer.

courseKey.description: Course key unlocked by this code.

used.description: Whether this one-time activation code has already been redeemed.

createdByUid.description: UID of the admin who generated this code.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the code was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the code was updated or redeemed.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores public profile, unlocked courses, and learning progress for each user.

/users/{userId}/private/{infoId}.description: Stores isolated PII (email) accessible strictly by the owner or admin.

/activationCodes/{codeId}.description: Stores one-time course activation codes bound to a specific student email.
